description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaHandler class within the org.openmrs.obs package. The tests verify supported views, media type recognition, and correct handling of complex data associated with Obs objects in the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: MediaHandlerTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class that extends BaseContextSensitiveTest to test MediaHandler's functionality related to media type support and saving complex data Observations.

methods.name: shouldReturnSupportedViews
methods.description: Tests that the MediaHandler returns the correct supported views, specifically the RAW view.

methods.name: shouldSupportRawView
methods.description: Verifies that the MediaHandler supports the RAW view.

methods.name: shouldNotSupportOtherViews
methods.description: Ensures the MediaHandler does not support various non-RAW views and invalid inputs.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldRetrieveCorrectMimetype
methods.description: Tests that saving an Obs with complex data correctly sets the MIME type to 'audio/mpeg' when saving an MP3 file, including handling of duplicate filenames.
